description: Buy or sell pressure of a pair's funded order book: a score from 0 to 100 and its band, from the depth near mid. When to use: To measure how the funded depth near mid of a pair's order book is split between bids and asks, as one score with its band. Prefer another tool: To read the order book levels (use `/v1/xrpl/orderbook`), the cost of a trade of a given size, CLOB against AMM (use `/v1/xrpl/slippage`), or an AMM pool (use `/v1/xrpl/amm/{a}/{b}`). Example: xrpl_metrics_pressure {"base":"XRP","quote":"5553444300000000000000000000000000000000.rGm7WCVp9gb4jZHWTEtGUr4dd74z2XuWhE"}

base.description: Base currency of the book: `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code.

quote.description: Quote currency of the book, different from base: `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code.

name: xrpl_metrics_pressure

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

band.description: Band of the score, a defined computation and not advice; null without a score

ask_depth.description: Funded quantity of the asks priced within the band, units of `base`

bid_depth.description: Funded quantity of the bids priced within the band, units of `base`

half_width_bps.description: Band half-width around mid, in basis points: 10, 50 or 100

imbalance_ratio.description: Depth imbalance, a fraction: (bid_depth − ask_depth) / (bid_depth + ask_depth), from -1 (asks only) to 1 (bids only); null when both depths are 0

bands.description: Depth per side within 10, 50 and 100 bps of mid; null for a one-sided book

base.description: Base asset queried, in the canonical form the route reads (echo)

base_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `base`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

figure.description: The book statistic of the direct pair, in its base: spread_bps, spread / mid in basis points; depth_bid_k and depth_ask_k, the funded base quantity of the bids or asks priced within k bps of mid, bounds included; its live value (`live`) is the same statistic of this request's book, spread_bps not rounded to 2 decimals

live.description: The route's live value of the figure, the one the z-score compares with the stored values; null when the route has none

mean.description: Mean of the stored values; null while warming up

median.description: Median of the stored values; null while warming up

points.description: Stored slots of the figure in the window

stddev.description: Population standard deviation of the stored values (over the stored points); null while warming up

zscore.description: (live − mean) / population standard deviation of the stored values, rounded half-up to 2 decimals; null while warming up, when the standard deviation is 0 or without a live value

window.description: The baseline window: the 672 15-minute slots (7 days) up to the current one

baseline.description: The 7-day stored baseline of the book of the metric's direct pair, in the metric's base and quote order; null while every figure warms up, when no stored series tracks the pair, or when the stored series cannot be read or lacks a figure

best_ask.description: Price of the best funded ask, quote per base, an input of mid and spread_bps; null when the ask side is empty

best_bid.description: Price of the best funded bid, quote per base, an input of mid and spread_bps; null when the bid side is empty

mid.description: Midpoint of the best bid and best ask, quote per base; null for a one-sided book

quote.description: Quote asset queried, in the canonical form the route reads (echo)

quote_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `quote`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

reasons.description: Why the score is null (one_sided_book, no_depth_within_band), then at most one baseline reason: warming_up while a baseline figure has fewer than 288 stored slots; not_tracked when no stored series tracks the pair; baseline_unavailable when the stored series cannot be read or lacks a figure; empty otherwise

score.description: Integer from 0 to 100: round-half-up(50 × (1 + imbalance_ratio of the 50 bps band)); null when the book is one-sided or has no depth within that band

spread_bps.description: Spread of the best prices in basis points, rounded half-up to 2 decimals; null for a one-sided book

title: XRPL buy pressure
